1.72.71

  • Theater controls actually clickable (pointer-events fix)
  • Below-stage dock: studio, live tour share, sun dial
  • Real sun simulation: equinox sun path, time slider, direct-sun facade rings, stage sun marker

  • Window view: direction-named tab, bigger viewport, full screen
  • Single H1 per project page
  • Maps: cooperative gestures (no scroll-trap), small dots with small labels
